name: io.github.pdfluent/pdfluent-mcp
title: PDFluent
description: Read, search and fill PDFs as markdown, text, tables, forms. Your documents stay on your machine.

packageArguments.name: --root
packageArguments.description: A directory the server may read and write in; repeat for more than one.

environmentVariables.name: PDFLUENT_MCP_MAX_BYTES
environmentVariables.description: Largest document the server opens, in bytes (default 104857600).

environmentVariables.name: PDFLUENT_MCP_MAX_OUTPUT_CHARS
environmentVariables.description: Longest result one call returns, in characters (default 200000).
